fields.title: Cyclic Ramsey conjecture for stars and monotone paths
fields.review_depth: Source (Basic, Damnjanovic, Stevanovic, Stosic, arXiv:2604.16188v1) Sections 1-4 and 6 read; definitions of cyclic embedding, S_a^sc, P_b^mon and R_cyc taken literally; Theorem 4.5 (lower bound) proof read; Table 11 transcribed.
fields.mathematical_attempts_and_coverage: Full proof for all a>=3, b>=4 (PROOF-374241.md). Lower bound: source Theorem 4.5 block colouring. Upper bound: new Theorem A (jump functions J,K with J,K<=t+1 and J+K<=t+2, forced equality of the greedy span, orbit wraps to u-1 contradicting K(u)=1). Exact extremal min-degree n-ceil(n/(b-2)) confirmed by SAT for b=4,5,6, n<=13 (logs/mindeg-b*.log) as a diagnostic. Lean endpoint CycRamsey.cycRamsey_startStar_monPath proves the literal equality including the definitions and the lower-bound construction.
fields.remaining_lemmas_or_limits: No mathematical gap known. Remaining: independent adversarial review, statement-fidelity review of the Lean definitions (Sym2 colouring, Fin-addition rotation, fromRel graphs, sInf via IsLeast), wider prior-art search for Dirac-type results on convex geometric graphs, significance judgment by root.

fields.title: Direction-flip conjecture for oriented paths
fields.review_depth: Definitions of TS/TAS; Proposition 2.2 proof and Conjecture 2.3
fields.mathematical_attempt: The six-edge source counterexample has pattern right,left,right,right,right,left and three flips, not one. No source-internal contradiction. Source verifies lengths through7.

No ratio>1 found. Float diagnostics not proofs.
